keys.manual_admin.tools.interfaz.title: Interface
keys.manual_admin.tools.interfaz.tv_desc: Controls when the TV version card and link appear on the home screen: never, always, or only on older devices (detects outdated browsers and automatically offers them the lightweight version).
keys.manual_admin.tools.interfaz.standalone_d: Shows or hides the card and link to solo mode (standalone.html) on the home screen.
keys.manual_admin.tools.interfaz.animar_fondo: Turns the background gradient and leaf motion on or off across every screen. When disabled, the background stays static.
keys.manual_admin.tools.interfaz.animacion_in: Before each game (Trivial included) the presenter, TV and phones show the animated Xiro! logo and a 3, 2, 1, 0 countdown. Sound plays on the presenter only. The first question's timer does not start until it ends. Enabled by default.
keys.manual_admin.tools.interfaz.podio_3d_des: On the presenter's final podium, the top three rise as gold, silver and bronze 3D blocks in time with the music, and confetti falls on the winner. 4th to 10th stay in rows below. With the system's reduce motion setting, the blocks appear already built and without confetti. If the browser has no WebGL2, the podium is shown as rows as usual. On by default.
keys.manual_admin.tools.interfaz.reactions_de: When no question is open (lobby, slides, after answering (in team mode, once the whole team has answered), reveal and ranking), players can send emojis from their phone; they float up the right-hand column of the presenter screen and the TV. They are anonymous and score nothing. Pick the 6 emojis on the bar (in the order you tick them) or press Reset. The presenter can mute them during the game from the ⋯ menu, with the R key or from the remote control. Changes apply to new games.
keys.manual_admin.tools.interfaz.personalizat: Shows an event branding badge (e.g. a sponsor's logo) on every screen of the game. Lets you upload, pick and delete the logo directly from this panel.
